postExecutionEvaluation.explanation: The original Node command completed all 23 controls with exit zero and complete streams. Its wrapper expected TAP, but this direct node:test invocation emitted the SPEC reporter. The wrapper therefore exited one with no parsed TAP cases. A read-only SPEC-specific evaluation independently checked the same raw stream digests, all 23 exact names and totals, and rechecked source pins. No Node command was replayed and no source result was relabelled as a new execution.

implementedBehavior.timestampRange: 0 through 2^128-1; globally nondecreasing in the recorder's synchronous event order
implementedBehavior.errorFraction: Exact non-success numerator and terminal denominator; pending and refused observations reported separately.
implementedBehavior.balanceUnits: Caller-declared nonnegative bigint units, each and sum <= 2^128-1.

evidenceLimits: All test timestamps, outcomes and balances are synthetic DATA. This module reads no native clock and executes no application operation.
Recorded test-run durations are not funding latency, funded-call latency, ledger concurrency, sustained load or TPS.
COMPLETE describes recorder coverage, not operational success. UNKNOWN may be completely recorded without becoming a successful operation.
An UNKNOWN terminal timestamp is the time the caller declared uncertainty, not proof the underlying operation terminated.
Expected ledger values are caller-declared. Matching them does not authenticate the ledger or establish correctness under actual contention.
The recorder's limits constrain its own observations, not application admission, memory bytes, CPU time, resource cancellation or native cleanup.
No real measurement driver, pilot, native HTTPS, SDK/SQLite integration, forced-kill/reopen or current-head hosted CI qualification is established.
The existing whole-demo local benchmark and P0 current qualification profile are unchanged; this is a separate opt-in recorder lane.
The selected native V3 results from the prior batch are neither replayed nor expanded by these DATA controls.

publicationBoundary.scope: The four-file candidate is a standalone DATA module, its selected controls, this result and usage documentation. No package/default/driver/workflow change, broad test, CI dispatch, PR state change, network/payment capability or native authority is added.
